rationale: Patients need warmth, calm, and trust when dealing with health. A dark UI feels too clinical and cold. The organic & earthy palette instills groundedness and professionalism without triggering anxiety.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-text_primary font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-text_primary font-heading
hierarchy.small_label: text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-secondary font-body

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x typical). Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for marketing sections to let content breathe.
spacing_and_layout.landing_page_grid: Mode A: The Tetris Grid (Asymmetric). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B: The Control Room Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

cards_and_surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border (#E2E8E4) and generous padding (p-8).
cards_and_surfaces.dashboard_widgets: Cardless or flat solid surface (bg-white) with 1px border (#E2E8E4). Max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg).
cards_and_surfaces.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism if floating: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/40.

components_strategy.marketing: Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS. Avoid rigid Shadcn wrappers for layout. Use custom HTML for bento grids.
components_strategy.dashboard_and_booking: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the Organic & Earthy theme (remove Vercel-look, adjust radii and borders). Use Shadcn Calendar for date selection, Select for dropdowns.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-primary text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors. Secondary buttons: bg-surface text-primary border border-primary hover:bg-background_base.
components_strategy.charts: Use Shadcn charts (Recharts) with deep green (#2C5545) and sage (#8A9A86) accents.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must change state. Buttons: subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) and color change.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.

icons.style: Use regular weight, stroke-width 1.5. Clean and legible.

hero_background.description: Warm and inviting medical center reception showcasing contemporary design with wood panel accents.
hero_background.usage: Landing page hero section background. MUST have an overlay of bg-white/40 to ensure text contrast.

feature_image_1.description: A doctor and patient engaging in a positive consultation in a bright clinic setting.
feature_image_1.usage: About Us or How It Works section.

testimonial_doctor_1.description: A smiling doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope provides a warm consultation.
testimonial_doctor_1.usage: Featured Doctor card or Testimonial section.

abstract_accent.usage: Background texture for secondary sections or CTA blocks. Overlay with heavy white gradient if needed.

clinic_interior.usage: Bento grid filler image or footer background.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. e.g. data-testid='booking-submit-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend Tailwind configuration with the custom colors defined here.
Import Outfit and Manrope fonts in index.css.
Do not use generic Shadcn Card component for marketing sections; use pure HTML bento grids.
Use Phosphor or Lucide icons for all UI elements.
Ensure all backgrounds have slight tint (Bone White) rather than pure white, except for top-level cards.
Implement the PhonePe gateway button with the primary color, ensuring strong contrast.
Never use pure black text. Use the defined text_primary (#1A2421).
Ensure the dashboard uses a dense grid structure without excessive padding inside widgets to maximize data visibility.
